definition.heading: 1. What is PU Injection Waterproofing?
definition.intro: PU stands for Polyurethane. PU Injection (also known as PU Grouting) is an advanced waterproofing technique used specifically to stop active water leaks through cracks in concrete structures.
definition.science: Liquid polyurethane resin is injected directly into the concrete crack using a high-pressure pump. The magic happens when this resin comes into contact with the water trapped inside the wall. It reacts instantly, expanding up to 30 times its original volume to form a dense, tough, waterproof foam. This foam perfectly fills every microscopic void, permanently sealing the water's path.
definition.closing: Because it specifically targets the inside of the concrete slab, it is the most effective PU injection waterproofing KL residents can use for basement leaks, leaking RC flat roofs, and dripping plaster ceilings originating from the bathroom above.

causes.heading: 2. Why Do Concrete Walls & Ceilings Crack?
causes.intro: Concrete is strong, but it is not invincible. If you are looking for a wall crack repair service KL, your property is likely suffering from one of the following:

items.heading: Thermal Expansion:
items.text: Kuala Lumpur experiences scorching heat followed by sudden, freezing thunderstorms. This rapid temperature change causes concrete to expand and contract daily, eventually leading to hairline fractures.

items.heading: Building Settlement:
items.text: As a new house settles into the ground over its first few years, the structural shift naturally causes minor cracks in the walls and foundation.

items.heading: Degraded Waterproofing Membranes:
items.text: The original waterproofing layer laid by the developer under your bathroom tiles usually degrades after 5 to 10 years, allowing water to seep into the concrete slab.

process.heading: 3. How the PU Grouting Process Works (No Hacking)
process.intro: The greatest advantage of PU injection is that it requires zero hacking. You don't have to destroy your beautiful, expensive bathroom tiles to fix the leak underneath them. Here is our step-by-step process:

items.heading: Leak Identification
items.text: We inspect the yellow stains or dripping areas on your ceiling or wall to identify the exact path of the water.

items.heading: Drilling Injection Holes
items.text: We drill small, highly precise holes (about 45 degrees) intersecting the crack in the concrete slab.

items.heading: Inserting Packers
items.text: We insert mechanical injection packers (metal valves) into the drilled holes. These will act as the gateway for the resin.

items.heading: High-Pressure Injection
items.text: Using a specialized high-pressure machine, we pump the liquid polyurethane resin through the packers. You will literally see the expanding foam push the trapped water out of the crack before sealing it completely.

items.heading: Curing & Finishing
items.text: Once the foam cures (hardens), we remove the packers, clean off the excess foam, and patch the drill holes with waterproof cement.

pricing.heading: 4. 2026 Cost Guide for PU Injection in KL
pricing.intro: Unlike traditional hacking methods which cost thousands of Ringgit in new tiles, cement, and labor, PU Injection is incredibly cost-effective. Pricing is typically calculated "per point" (the number of injection packers needed to cover the length of the crack).
